headline: Amendments made to tax legislation » Gazeta.kg - Kyrgyzstan and Bishkek news today
summary: President Sadyr Japarov signed amendments to Kyrgyz legislation on taxation and non-tax revenues. The law enters into force in August 2026 and aims to improve the tax system.
why: Tax changes alter the cost of doing business and fiscal revenue, which matters for investors assessing a frontier economy's policy direction.
